articles.title: Punjab Woman ‘Goes Missing’ in Pakistan — Reappears as Noor Hussain After Secret Marriage!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 52-year-old woman from Punjab, earlier reported missing during a Sikh pilgrimage to Pakistan, has been found to have voluntarily stayed back, changed her name and married a Pakistani man.

body.html:
A 52-year-old woman from Punjab, earlier reported missing during a Sikh pilgrimage to Pakistan, has been found to have voluntarily stayed back, changed her name and married a Pakistani man.

Sarabjit Kaur, a resident of Amainipur in Kapurthala district, had travelled with a jatha of 1,932 pilgrims through the Attari border on 4 November for the birth anniversary of Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji. While the group returned after 10 days, Sarabjit did not come back.

During the probe, Indian agencies discovered that she had married a Pakistani national, Nasir Hussain, and adopted the name Noor Hussain. Her Nikahnama confirmed the development.

Authorities also found that Sarabjit left key details like nationality and passport number blank in her Pakistani immigration form, making her difficult to trace.

Sarabjit, divorced and facing past NDPS-related cases along with her two sons, had reportedly planned the move in advance. When Punjab Police visited her village, the family offered no details.

The case has raised serious questions about how she was allowed to travel alone, despite earlier restrictions after a similar 2018 incident involving Kiran Bala. The role of the Pakistani High Commission and oversight by SGPC is also under scrutiny.

articles.title: Pune Horror: Truck Brake Failure Triggers Massive Pile-Up, 9 Dead, 20 Injured — Car Burned Alive
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major tragedy unfolded near Navale Bridge on the outskirts of Pune on Thursday (13 Nov 2025) evening after a truck’s brakes failed, leading to a massive collision involving 20–25 vehicles on the Pune–Nashik Highway near Bhorgaon.

body.html:
A major tragedy unfolded near Navale Bridge on the outskirts of Pune on Thursday (13 Nov 2025) evening after a truck’s brakes failed, leading to a massive collision involving 20–25 vehicles on the Pune–Nashik Highway near Bhorgaon.

Police said the truck rammed into a car, which then crashed into a container ahead, causing all three vehicles to catch fire. The impact was so severe that the car was crushed between the trucks and went up in flames within seconds, killing all five occupants.

In total, nine people — including the truck driver — died in the accident, and nearly 20 others were injured. A passenger vehicle behind the truck also caught fire, injuring 17–18 people. Traffic on the busy stretch remained disrupted for about an hour.

Fire and rescue teams reached the spot promptly and extinguished the blaze. The deceased are being identified, and the injured have been shifted to nearby hospitals.

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis announced ₹5 lakh compensation for the families of the deceased and assured support for the injured. MP Supriya Sule also expressed grief over the tragedy.

articles.title: “Sadhus” Turned Robbers: Family Looted on Highway in Broad Daylight — Shocking Video Sparks Outrage!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational robbery took place on Tuesday afternoon near Bheru Dungri in the Lalghati police station limits of Shajapur district, where two men disguised as sadhus looted a family travelling from Indore to Sarangpur for a wedding.

body.html:
A sensational robbery took place on Tuesday afternoon near Bheru Dungri in the Lalghati police station limits of Shajapur district, where two men disguised as sadhus looted a family travelling from Indore to Sarangpur for a wedding.

A viral video shows the accused blocking the road on NH-52 and snatching gold jewellery from women sitting inside the car. The incident triggered massive public anger online.

According to complainant Shahrukh, four men dressed as sadhus suddenly stood in front of the vehicle and, under the guise of offering blessings, forcibly took two gold rings and a gold chain with a pendant. They allegedly threatened the family with death when they resisted before fleeing towards Indore or Ujjain.

Following the viral video, police launched immediate action. By Tuesday evening, Ujjain police arrested seven members of a gang that routinely posed as sadhus to commit robberies across Ujjain, Dewas, and Shajapur districts.

Ujjain SP Pradeep Sharma said the gang was also involved in multiple robberies in Delhi and Haryana in August 2025. Police recovered two gold rings and ₹5,000 in cash from the accused.

articles.title: Bengaluru Radiologist Accused of Sexually Harassing Woman During Scan, Still Absconding
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case has surfaced from Anekal, on Bengaluru’s outskirts, where a 34-year-old woman was allegedly sexually harassed by a radiologist during a medical scan at Plasma Medinostics.

body.html:
A shocking case has surfaced from Anekal, on Bengaluru’s outskirts, where a 34-year-old woman was allegedly sexually harassed by a radiologist during a medical scan at Plasma Medinostics.

The accused, identified as Jayakumar, reportedly touched the woman’s private parts under the guise of conducting a scan around 3 p.m. on Monday (10 Nov 2025). When questioned, he allegedly shouted at her and asked her to leave if she had doubts.

Acting on her husband’s advice, the woman recorded a second scan on her phone, capturing the radiologist’s inappropriate behaviour. She later filed a police complaint, submitting the video as evidence.

Despite this, police have not arrested Jayakumar. Reports suggest he briefly appeared at the station but was allowed to leave and fled in his SUV. The victim’s family staged a protest outside the station, accusing the police of negligence. However, Anekal police officials denied these allegations, claiming the accused remains absconding and efforts are underway to trace him.

A case has been registered under IPC Sections 354 (sexual harassment), 506 (criminal intimidation), and 504 (intentional insult to provoke breach of peace).

The woman is currently undergoing treatment at Rajiv Gandhi Hospital, Bengaluru. The incident has sparked widespread outrage, with calls growing louder for stricter accountability in medical and police systems dealing with sexual assault complaints.
